svg.aria-label: Runtime: users reach two nginx pods through an Azure load balancer, nginx proxies /api/ to four Flask pods, which use one Redis pod with a 2Gi volume. Argo CD polls k8s/ on GitHub and syncs the default namespace. The kubelet identity pulls images from ACR with AcrPull.

g.text: 2 × D2s_v5 · k8s 1.35.8 · azure cni overlay · public api server · system-assigned identity
what argo cd keeps in sync
only the frontend gets a public ip · backend and redis are clusterip only
kubelet identity → role AcrPull on the registry
pull: argo cd polls git, kubelet pulls images
